section_summary.extract_value: Study 1 describes the development and validation of the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS), which is hypothesized to have two factors measuring restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages and pressure to eat. The study examines the association between caregiver eating messages and participant reports of positive body attitudes and adaptive eating behaviors to establish validity evidence for the CEMS.
